# Polish Checklist: QuickFlow Phase 8 (Accessibility, Performance, Regression)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the cross-cutting accessibility, motion, responsive, performance, persistence and regression requirements exercised by T105–T107.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive): depth Standard, audience Reviewer (release gate), focus Accessibility + Performance, regression/persistence included.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are accessible-name requirements stated for every control type (buttons, icon buttons, toggles, inputs, selects, links)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are landmark and heading structure requirements (main region, one page heading) specified, or only implied by WCAG 2.1 AA? [Gap, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is focus return after closing dialogs specified as a requirement? [Gap, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for how validation messages are announced (live region vs. alert role)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are performance targets defined for create/update/delete on every entity type (tasks, habits incl. completion, learning cards incl. milestones, plans incl. item toggle, settings)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the persistence requirement explicit about application restart (not only browser session reload)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, §SC-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "4.5:1" defined for all text sizes, or are large-text (3:1) exceptions intentionally excluded? [Clarity, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "typical local use" in SC-002 quantified (data volume, warm vs. cold, measurement point)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "shows results in under 500 ms" defined as server response time, UI render time, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "MUST NOT block input" during animations defined in a measurable way? [Measurability, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "disabled when the user prefers reduced motion" quantified (zero duration vs. shortened)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Are the 375 px–1440 px layout requirements consistent with the dialog and navigation requirements on small screens? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK013 - Do contrast requirements apply consistently to both light and dark themes and to status/badge colors? [Consistency, Spec §SC-010, §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the 1,000-item list limit (FR-035) consistent with the 1,000-task performance target (SC-009)? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 - Can "every page action can be done with the keyboard alone" be objectively enumerated per page? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the PRD §11 end-to-end flow enumerated step-by-step so pass/fail is unambiguous? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is "plan status identical after reopening" measurable against a defined computation rule? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 - Are truncation/wrapping requirements defined for maximum-length titles (200 chars) and notes (5,000 chars)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are requirements defined for the countdown and progress animations under reduced motion? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are recovery requirements defined when the backend is unavailable during a restart (UI error state)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are performance requirements specified for combined filters (search + status + priority + date range + sort)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-009]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK022 - Is the assumption of a single local user and local database (no network latency) documented as the basis for timing targets? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the target browser/assistive-technology set for the WCAG 2.1 AA claim documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-034]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
